title: Y Combinator applications are getting longer, with more em dashes. Guess why.
excerpt: Applications to Y Combinator grew 60% in length over the past three years, one partner wrote. Another pointed out the use of em dashes, suspecting AI.
content_html:
If it talks like AI, and it walks like AI, it might just be AI.

An application to the startup accelerator Y Combinator includes several written prompts. Founders need to explain how they picked the idea, who their competitors are, and how they'll make money. Many techies have offloaded their writing skills to AI — and application data suggests it shows in their applications.

YC applications have grown by 60% in length over the past three years, according to partner Tyler Bosmeny. "I wonder what could explain that..." he wrote on X.

Pete Koomen, another YC partner, wrote on X that he noticed a difference. He thought: "Back in my day (one year ago) founders didn't talk like this."

The word "wedge" began to rise in prevalence in 2025, according to a graph Koomen shared. By the summer 2026 batch, the word was in about 20% of applications.

Em dashes took off a bit earlier, starting in 2023 and accelerating in 2024. By the summer 2025 batch, em dashes were used in over 50% of YC applications, according to the data.

Koomen pointed out that the spacing of the em dashes mattered. The use of em dashes with spaces around them (so spaced — exactly — like this) spiked in summer 2025. That's also when "wedge" spiked, Koomen said, and coincides with the launch of Anthropic's Opus 4.

The results aren't uniform. One of the suspected trademark words of AI-generated writing is "delve." Koomen found that it spiked in winter 2024 — but never appeared in more than 1.25% of applications.

Should I use AI in my Y Combinator application?

Y Combinator doesn't have specific guidance about AI use in its applications, unlike some companies like Anthropic. Its former and current leaders have shared some conflicting viewpoints.

CEO Garry Tan said he writes with AI during an appearance on the "Naval" podcast in July.

"I sure do," Tan said. "You caught me."

Tan said that you can "fix" when AI writes poorly. When one of the podcast hosts said that good writing was a product of good thinking, Tan countered that he was having "high-bandwidth conversations" with an AI model.

Paul Graham, YC's retired cofounder, has taken a more negative view. In May, he posted on X about the emails he received from founders, which were written in a "hard-hitting journalistic style."

These emails are written by AI, Graham wrote. He instantly moves on: "It feels like being lied to, and who would stand for that?"

Graham has also narrowed in on the word "delve." It's not that he dislikes the word, he wrote in 2024, but that it's a sign of ChatGPT use.

Still, YC seems invested in the future of AI-generated writing. There are at least two YC-backed startups that specialize in it.

content_html_zh:
如果它像人工智能一样说话，像人工智能一样行走，那么它可能就是人工智能。

启动加速器 Y Combinator 的应用程序包括几个书面提示。 创始人需要解释他们是如何选择这个想法的，他们的竞争对手是谁，以及他们将如何赚钱。 许多技术人员已经将他们的写作技能转移给人工智能——应用程序数据表明这一点在他们的应用程序中得到了体现。

据合作伙伴泰勒·博斯梅尼 (Tyler Bosmeny) 称，在过去三年中，YC 申请的长度增长了 60%。 “我想知道什么可以解释……” 他在X上写道。

另一位 YC 合伙人 Pete Koomen 在 X 上写道，他注意到了差异。 他想：“在我那个时代（一年前），创始人不会这样说话。”

根据 Koomen 分享的图表，“楔子”一词在 2025 年开始流行。 到 2026 年夏季批次，这个词出现在大约 20% 的申请中。

Em dashes 的起飞时间要早一些，从 2023 年开始，并在 2024 年加速。 数据显示，到 2025 年夏季批次，超过 50% 的 YC 应用程序都使用了长破折号。

库曼指出，破折号的间距很重要。 2025 年夏季，长破折号的使用量激增，周围有空格（间隔如此之大——完全如此——就像这样）。 Koomen 说，这也是“楔子”飙升的时候，并且恰逢 Anthropic Opus 4 的发布。

结果并不统一。 人工智能生成的写作中可疑的商标词之一是“delve”。 Koomen 发现该比例在 2024 年冬季激增，但从未出现在超过 1.25% 的申请中。

我应该在 Y Combinator 应用程序中使用 AI 吗？

与 Anthropic 等公司不同，Y Combinator 没有关于在其应用程序中使用人工智能的具体指导。 其前任和现任领导人持有一些相互矛盾的观点。

首席执行官 Garry Tan 在 7 月份出现在“Naval”播客中时表示，他使用人工智能进行写作。

“我当然知道，”谭说。 “你抓住了我。”

谭说，当人工智能写得不好时，你可以“修复”。 当一位播客主持人说好的写作是好的思考的产物时，谭反驳说他正在与人工智能模型进行“高带宽对话”。

YC 已退休的联合创始人保罗·格雷厄姆 (Paul Graham) 持更为负面的看法。 5 月份，他在 X 上发布了他从创始人那里收到的电子邮件，这些电子邮件以“强硬的新闻风格”撰写。

格雷厄姆写道，这些电子邮件是由人工智能撰写的。 他立即继续说道：“感觉就像被欺骗了，谁会忍受这种感觉呢？”

格雷厄姆还缩小了“钻研”这个词的范围。 他在 2024 年写道，并不是他不喜欢这个词，而是这是使用 ChatGPT 的标志。

尽管如此，YC 似乎还是对人工智能生成写作的未来进行了投资。 至少有两家 YC 支持的初创公司专门从事这一领域。
